feats.title: Bael Turath Born
feats.description: Your fire resistance improves; you now have resist fire 8 + your level.

feats.title: Fiendish Defender
feats.description: Infernal Wrath gains another trigger: an enemy you have marked hits an ally with an attack that does not target you.

feats.title: Infernal Sneak Attack
feats.description: When dealing Sneak Attack damage, you may expend Infernal Wrath to add 1d6 fire damage per die of Sneak Attack damage dealt.

feats.title: Tail Trip
feats.description: A hit with an opportunity attack or an attack granted by Combat Challenge lets you knock the enemy prone.
feats.note: Also listed as Tail Whip in the former Fighter feat list.

feats.title: Wrathful Hunter
feats.description: Using Infernal Wrath against your quarry grants a +3 power bonus to your next attack against it made by the end of your next turn.
